card.name: Just before dose increment amounts
card.fires_on: The space or the word "of" or "in" right before a mg amount in phrases about dose increments, such as "increments of 5 mg" or "in 5 mg increments".

modes.label: Increments of
modes.description: The gap after "increments of" or "decrements of", just before a mg number.
modes.example: When dosage adjustments are necessary, dose increments/decrements of<< >>5 mg QD are recommended.

modes.label: Raised in increments
modes.description: The word "of" after "increments" in dose-raising instructions, just before a mg amount.
modes.example: daily dosage may be raised in increments<< of>> 10 mg at weekly intervals until

modes.label: In ... increments
modes.description: The gap after "in" before a mg amount and the word increments.
modes.example: Subsequent dose increases should be administered in<< >>5 mg increments.

card.plain: It fires on the spot just before the size of a dose step, like the 5 mg in "increase in 5 mg steps".
